Lemon and Herb Chickpea Bowl

SERVES 2

INGREDIENTS

for the chickpeas
1 can chickpeas, drained
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 teaspoon smoked paprika

for the dressing
2 tablespoons tahini
1 lemon, juiced
1 small garlic clove, grated
a pinch of salt

to serve
2 cups cooked rice
a handful of parsley leaves

METHOD

1. Warm the olive oil in a pan and fry the chickpeas with the smoked paprika for 5 minutes, until they start to crisp.
2. Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, garlic and salt, loosening with a splash of water.
3. Pile the rice into bowls, spoon over the chickpeas, drizzle with the dressing and scatter the parsley on top.
